lines.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

data.define: To cost so much that you can't afford it.

example.text: Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.

misuse.text: Don't say 'break the bank' at a bank.
misuse.why: It only means costing too much.

data.l1_ex: Đừng lo, bữa trưa này sẽ không break the bank đâu.

native.tip: “break the bank” = Tốn cả gia tài. Ví dụ: “Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.”
native.caption:
“break the bank” nghĩa là gì?
“break the bank” = Tốn cả gia tài.
Ví dụ: “Don't worry, this lunch won't break the bank.” (Đừng lo, bữa trưa này sẽ không break the bank đâu.)
